title: 第95章 回去跟你喝西北风？
content_zh:
第95章 回去跟你喝西北风？-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

上一章

存书签

下一章

中午饭点，店里忙得脚不沾地。

赵志军在厨房炒菜，王大柱传菜，孙小丽点单。

林国强两头跑，后厨和前厅来回蹿。

李红霞站在柜台旁边，犹豫了一下，挽起袖子，端了一盘菜送到桌上。

林国强从后厨出来，看见了。

母子俩对视了一瞬。

林国强没说什么，转身回了后厨。

但李红霞心里松了口气。

国强没赶她走。

从那以后，李红霞天天往饭店跑。

早上来，帮林静林薇洗脸穿衣裳。

上午带着两个丫头在院子里玩，给她们扎小辫。

中午店里忙的时候，她帮着端盘子收碗。

下午两个孩子睡午觉，她就在院子里纳鞋底，守着。

王桂兰伺候赵素梅坐月子，她插不上手。

但带孩子、端盘子，她干得了。

有一天傍晚，林静从院子里跑进来，拉着林国强的手。

“爹，奶奶今天给我扎了两个小辫！”

林国强低头看了看。

两根小辫，用红头绳扎着，歪歪扭扭的。

“好看。”他说。

林静高高兴兴跑了。

李红霞站在院子里，把一切都看在眼里。

她转过身去，拿袖子擦了擦眼角。

林庆安满月那天，国强饭店摆了五桌。

赵德厚和王桂兰来了。

赵素芳和孙建国来了，赵素英和刘胜利来了。

刘强和周红带着刘建良、刘建英来了。

林美玲和陈建国带着孩子也来了。

林海柱和李红霞坐在上首。

林国伟来了，带着周桂芳和两个孩子。

大牛二丫围着林静转，想看新出生的弟弟。

林美丽也来了。

她胳膊上的绷带拆了，但还不能使力。

穿了一件素净的蓝布褂子，头发剪短了，脸上有了点肉，不像刚出院时那么瘦得吓人。

一个人来的，安安静静坐在角落里。

有人跟她说话，她就应一声。

没人说话，她就看着桌面。

林国栋没来。

徐青青还在娘家没回来。

林国强抱着林庆安出来，挨个给长辈看。

林庆安满月了，不再是皱巴巴的样子，白白净净的，眼睛乌溜溜的，不怕生，谁抱都行。

Chapter 95: Going back to drink northwest wind with you?- "Rebirth at 80, taking my wife and daughter to eat and drink after the family separation"

At lunch time, the store was so busy that I couldn’t even touch the floor.

Zhao Zhijun was cooking in the kitchen, Wang Dazhu passed the dishes and Sun Xiaoli took the order.

Lin Guoqiang ran in both directions, back and forth between the kitchen and the front hall.

Li Hongxia stood next to the counter, hesitated for a moment, rolled up her sleeves, and brought a plate of food to the table.

Lin Guoqiang came out of the kitchen and saw it.

Mother and son looked at each other for a moment.

Lin Guoqiang said nothing and turned back to the kitchen.

But Li Hongxia felt relieved.

Guoqiang did not drive her away.

From then on, Li Hongxia went to the restaurant every day.

Come in the morning and help Lin Jing and Lin Wei wash and dress.

In the morning, I took the two girls to play in the yard and tied their pigtails.

When the store was busy at noon, she helped carry plates and collect bowls.

In the afternoon, when the two children took a nap, she collected shoe soles in the yard and watched over them.

Wang Guilan was serving Zhao Sumei during her confinement period, but she couldn't get involved.

But she can take care of the children and serve the dishes.

One evening, Lin Jing ran in from the yard and took Lin Guoqiang's hand.

"Dad, grandma tied two pigtails for me today!"

Lin Guoqiang looked down.

Two pigtails, tied with red hair rope, crookedly.

"It looks good," he said.

Lin Jing ran away happily.

Li Hongxia stood in the yard and saw everything.

She turned around and wiped the corners of her eyes with her sleeve.

On Lin Qingan's full moon day, five tables were set up at the Guoqiang Hotel.

Zhao Dehou and Wang Guilan are here.

Zhao Sufang and Sun Jianguo came, Zhao Suying and Liu Shengli came.

Liu Qiang and Zhou Hong came with Liu Jianliang and Liu Jianying.

Lin Meiling and Chen Jianguo also came with their children.

Lin Haizhu and Li Hongxia sat at the top.

Lin Guowei came, taking Zhou Guifang and two children with him.

Danniu Erya circled around Lin Jing, wanting to see her new born brother.

Lin Meili also came.

The bandage on her arm was removed, but she still couldn't use it.

He was wearing a plain blue cloth gown, his hair was cut short, and his face had some flesh, and he was not as frighteningly thin as when he was first discharged from the hospital.

I came alone and sat quietly in the corner.

When someone spoke to her, she responded.

No one spoke, she just looked at the table.

Lin Guodong didn't come.

Xu Qingqing is still at her parents' house and has not returned.

Lin Guoqiang came out with Lin Qingan in his arms and showed them to the elders one by one.

Lin Qing'an is one month old. He is no longer wrinkled. He is fair and clean, with dark eyes. He is not afraid of strangers and can be held by anyone.
